paper_title: The topological susceptibility in finite temperature QCD and axion cosmology
notes: Lattice QCD study of topological susceptibility yielding a bound on the axion decay constant f_a <= 1.2e12 GeV in the f_a - T_osc plane. This is an AxionMass-type result (f_a bound). However, the main figure (Fig. 6) plots f_a vs T_osc (oscillation temperature), not f_a vs m_a, so a clean set of (mass_eV, f_a) data points is not extractable. Only a single bound f_a <= 1.2e12 GeV is quoted in text; no tabulated coupling-vs-mass data is available.
